description: This is a textured rug with a woven pattern. The fibers appear to be natural, possibly jute or a similar material, giving it a rustic and organic feel. The pattern is intricate, creating a sense of depth and visual interest without being overly busy. The color is a neutral, earthy tone that would complement a variety of decor styles. The rug is shown from an angled perspective, highlighting its texture and the way light plays off the woven surface. It appears to be a flat-weave rug, suitable for high-traffic areas or as a base layer for furniture.
